column1: # CMP2 group 219: slave-market branches and Zephal arena encounter (000C70C6-000C8A92)

column2: Long-haired beauty
Boyish brat
Slow fatso
Busty beauty
Slender beauty
Thank you very much for choosing me...
I will surely repay this kindness on the battlefield...!
Are you folks... the ones who chose me...?
No one chose me all week...
I was about to be fed to the beasts...
So I'm reeeally grateful!!
...Somehow,
I think you and I will get along just fine!!
Thank you so much for choosing someone like me...
To be honest, I'm no good at fighting, but please command me to provide $$夜伽$$...
...(Writing this in my $$日記$$!)
I'm so moved! I can't believe you'd rescue me twice...!!
I'm sorry you had to spend
a fortune just to rescue me...
Right after that, I got caught in a $$奴隷狩り$$'s trap...
From now on, I'll stay sharp and do my best!!
I was put up for $$セリ$$ like that as a child, too...
Saving one $$奴隷$$ does no good if this place remains. They'll only bring more $$奴隷$$s here...
I've lost count of how many times I've thought about burning this place to the ground!!
But even if we burn it down...
They'll only move the $$奴隷市$$ somewhere else. Nothing will truly change!
Unless we change $$この世$$...
is there really no way for us to have $$自由$$...!?
You're still the same...
Y-you are...
The $$剣闘士$$ called the black emperor, the strongest in history...
$$閃光のゼロ$$!!
Let me ask you something. That young lady there...
Don't tell me she's also a member of your battle team...?
And what if she is!?
Still the same, huh...
You're the only one, before or since, who ever dodged my slash and got away...
No one else has ever escaped it...
If you mean to settle things with me...
I'll be waiting in that $$闘技場$$...
That is, if you can keep winning long enough to reach me...
Just who is that man...?
He's the only man in the history of $$剣闘$$
who kept fighting despite having black $$羽$$...
And...
the man who took the sight from my right eye...
and killed my former wife...
Let's go...
One way or another... I have to settle things with him...
Are you idiots...?
What are you babbling on about!!
Y-you are...
The $$奴隷ハンター$$ called the $$退廃の剣闘士$$...
$$不発弾のゼファル$$!!
Let me ask you something. That muscular $$奴隷$$ there...
Don't tell me he's an ally of yours...?
And what if he is!?
No, it's just that, long ago, I tricked a muscle-brained idiot
and sent him off to prison...
He looked just like him.
Neener-neener, muscle-brain!!
No, no—those are the people owned by that $$邪道騎士$$ there
and myself, a $$神官$$... They are our $$奴隷$$s.
You must have mistaken someone else for them!!
Well, we'll leave it at that for now...
Hey, $$レブロブス$$...
If you want to settle things with me...
I'll be waiting in that $$闘技場$$...
Of course, that's assuming you can keep winning long enough to reach me...
Just who is he...?
He's the man who killed my parents...
Though he himself was a $$剣闘奴隷$$...
he captured other $$逃亡奴隷$$s with white $$羽$$ and sold them to $$奴隷商人$$s—a man rotten to the core...
And...
he set a filthy trap for me and threw me into that $$ゴルゴダ$$ prison...!!
Let's go...
One way or another... I have to settle things with him...
